mapper.select: SELECT A.sys_id AS "sysId", A.sys_nm AS "sysNm", A.user_theme_cd AS "userThemeCd", A.user_menu_layout_cd AS "userMenuLayoutCd", (SELECT file_sn FROM TN_COM_F001 WHERE file_grp_id = A.logo_file_grp_id AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY file_sn DESC LIMIT 1) AS "logoFileSn", (SELECT file_sn FROM TN_COM_F001 WHERE file_grp_id = A.banner_file_grp_id AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY file_sn DESC LIMIT 1) AS "bannerFileSn" FROM TN_SYS_M001 A WHERE A.sys_id = #{sysId} AND A.use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT M.menu_id AS "menuId", M.upr_menu_id AS "uprMenuId", M.menu_nm AS "menuNm", M.menu_url AS "menuUrl", M.sort_ord AS "sortOrd", M.login_required_yn AS "loginRequiredYn", M.required_grade_cd AS "requiredGradeCd", IFNULL(G.sort_ord, 0) AS "requiredGradeSortOrd" FROM TN_MNU_M001 M LEFT JOIN TN_COM_C002 G ON G.sys_id = 'CORE' AND G.grp_cd = 'USR_GRADE_CD' AND G.com_cd = M.required_grade_cd WHERE M.sys_id = #{sysId} AND M.sys_sect_cd = 'US' AND M.use_yn = 'Y' AND M.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY M.upr_menu_id ASC, M.sort_ord ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_COM_F001 F JOIN TN_SYS_M001 S ON S.sys_id = #{sysId} AND (F.file_grp_id = S.logo_file_grp_id OR F.file_grp_id = S.banner_file_grp_id) WHERE F.file_sn = #{fileSn} AND F.del_yn = 'N'
